title: 90-Minutes of Pottery Fun
blurb:
90 minutes of pottery for all ages. Join us with your friends and family members. It is an ideal journey for beginners and for those who have taken beginning pottery classes in the past and would like a refresher lesson. Join us to learn all about wheel throwing! Step-by-step instructions, wheel, tools, and all related supplies will be given.

At the end of the session you have the following options:

1- Walk out with your raw pottery creation. Or,
2- (Optional) Glaze your creation and fire it for $35. Or,
3- (Optional) Just fire -bisque it for $10

What to wear?
Shirts and shoes are required. Clay comes out of fabric without much effort, but we always suggest wearing clothes that you don't mind getting dirty.
